products.title: Sweat Tent Portable Outdoor Sauna — XL, Black, Pro-Bundle
products.body_html: The original Sweat Tent is a portable wood-fired sauna that delivers real 200°F+ heat anywhere you can build a fire. No construction, no permits, no electrician, no plumbing. Set it up in 15 minutes, light the stove, and step in. The multi-layer insulated tent holds heat below freezing temperatures, and the patented design has been tested in backyards, mountain cabins, and beach trips by over 10,000 owners. Wood-fired heat reaches temperatures electric and infrared can’t match, with zero EMF and real Finnish steam (löyly). Whether you’re recovering from training, building a daily wellness ritual, or sweating with friends, this is the sauna that goes wherever you do.

products.title: SunWrap Knee
products.body_html: Give your knees the recovery they deserve with targeted red light therapy, soothing heat, and relaxing massage in one cordless wrap. Designed to surround the entire knee, it combines 660nm red light and 850nm near infrared light to deliver full coverage while built in heat and vibration help you unwind after workouts, long days on your feet, or everyday activity. Simply strap it on, choose your settings, and enjoy hands free recovery wherever you are.

products.title: SunPanel Mini
products.body_html: Not everyone has a wall for a full panel. The SunPanel Mini puts 300 watts of red and near-infrared light on your desk. Sixty dual-chip LEDs deliver 630nm and 850nm through a focused 30 degree lens, so you can target your face, a sore shoulder, or a stiff knee from arm's length - then fold the stand and put it away. Near-zero EMF, white or black. The little sibling to the Panel Series, sized for your desk. Heat opens you up; light helps you rebuild.

products.title: SunMask
products.body_html: Most LED masks are heavy and sealed against your skin. The SunMask is built the opposite way - a breathable, food-grade silicone honeycomb that floats just off your face, so air moves and heat doesn't build. Inside, 280 medical-grade LEDs deliver red and near-infrared light for rejuvenation, blue for a clearer complexion, and yellow for tone - across your whole face at once. It's cordless, light, IP67 water-resistant, and runs on a simple 10-to-30-minute timer. Wear it over your skincare and sit back. Heat opens you up; light helps you rebuild.

products.title: SunBoot
products.body_html: After a long run, a heavy leg day, or a day on your feet, your legs carry it all. The SunBoot wraps each leg in 360 degrees of red and near-infrared light - 528 LEDs from foot to thigh, the most coverage Sweat Tent makes. The 660nm and 850nm wavelengths (a balanced 1:1) surround the calf, knee, and thigh at once, so both legs recover together while you sit back. Zip on, set the level, and let it work. Heat opens you up; light helps you rebuild.

products.title: SunBelt
products.body_html: Your lower back takes the brunt of every desk day, every lift, every long drive. The SunBelt wraps 105 red and near-infrared LEDs around your whole core, delivering 660nm and 850nm light across a full 51" span while three vibration levels work into tight muscle. It's cordless, adjustable, and hands-free - wrap it on and recover while you sit back. Heat opens you up; light helps you rebuild.

products.title: Sweat Tent Ice Bricks
products.body_html: The Sweat Tent Ice Bricks turn your freezer into an ice machine for cold therapy. Each collapsible silicone tray freezes into a big, solid brick that melts slower than cubed or bagged ice, holding your plunge colder for longer. One 6-tray set is sized to bring your Sweat Tent Plunge down to a true 40°F — then refreeze and go again.

products.title: Lifting Panel Stand
products.body_html:
The premium way to use your panel. The Lifting Panel Stand gives you height-adjustable, hands-free red light therapy sessions — standing, sitting, or lying down. Compatible with the Panel Series.

  • Height-adjustable for standing, sitting, and lying-down sessions
  • Universal compatibility — works with both Sweat Tent panel sizes
  • Sturdy metal and plastic construction with a 66 lb (30kg) load capacity
  • Floor-standing design — no wall mounting, no drilling

products.title: Mobile Panel Stand
products.body_html:
Roll your panel anywhere. The Panel Mobile Stand holds your Panel at the right angle and height, on wheels — so you can move your setup from room to room without remounting anything.

  • Rolling base for easy repositioning between rooms and sessions
  • Sturdy metal and plastic construction with a 66 lb (30kg) load capacity
  • Quick assembly — no tools, no wall drilling, no permanent installation

products.title: SunPOD Series
products.body_html:
Full-body red light therapy — no standing, no holding, no setup. The SunPod wraps you in 660nm and 850nm wavelengths from head to toe while you lay flat, turning any room into a recovery session.

  • Dual-wavelength red and near-infrared light therapy (660nm + 850nm)
  • External controller with pulse, dimming (10–100%), and Hz adjustment (0–100)
  • Folds flat for storage — sets up in seconds, no installation required
  • Available in POD18 PRO (71") for complete coverage or POD16 PRO (63") for smaller spaces

products.title: SunMAT Series
products.body_html:
Red light therapy that goes wherever you do. The SunMat Series delivers 660nm and 850nm wavelengths across a full-body surface — lay it on the floor, drape it on the couch, or roll it up and take it with you.

  • Dual wavelength red and near infrared light therapy (660nm + 850nm)
  • External controller with pulse, dimming (10–100%), and Hz adjustment (0–100)
  • Flexible design — use on any flat surface, rolls up for travel and storage
  • Available in MAT18 (2.6ft × 6ft) for full-body coverage or MAT16 (2ft × 5.3ft) for targeted sessions

products.title: Panel Series
products.body_html:
Four wavelengths. Clinical-grade output. Zero installation. The Panel Series delivers 630nm, 660nm, 810nm, and 850nm wavelengths for the most complete targeted light therapy session available — put against a wall, set it on a stand, or use it wherever you need it.

  • 4-wavelength system: 630nm, 660nm, 810nm, and 850nm — including 810nm for deep tissue penetration
  • Stand-compatible — works with the Panel Stands
  • Plugs into any standard outlet — no special wiring, no electrician

products.title: Premium Hardwood Flooring
products.body_html:
Real wood flooring for your Sweat Tent — no cold ground, no uneven footing, no setup hassle. Premium hardwood panels snap together in seconds, turning your tent into a finished space.

  • Premium hardwood — warm underfoot, built for humidity and heat
  • Snaps together in seconds — no tools or hardware
  • Available in Large (36 panels) for the Large Sweat Tent, or XL (85 panels) for the XL Sweat Tent

products.title: XPTLife 12 Month Subscription
products.body_html:
XPT (Extreme Performance Training) is an elite breathwork, recovery, and fitness app designed by world-renowned athletes Laird Hamilton & Gabby Reece to help you:

  • Enhance Your Performance – Scientifically backed breathwork and training programs to improve endurance, strength, and mental clarity.
  • Recover Like a Pro – Guided sauna and ice bath protocols to maximize recovery, reduce inflammation, and boost circulation.
  • Breathe with Purpose – Performance-driven breathwork techniques that help control stress, boost energy, and improve oxygen efficiency.
  • Train Smarter, Not Harder – Functional workouts used by top athletes to build mobility, power, and resilience.
  • Sleep & Stress Optimization – Guided breathwork and meditation practices to help you sleep deeper and recover faster.
  • Used by Elite Athletes & Navy SEALs – XPT’s proven methods are trusted by high performers across sports and military.

products.title: Sweat Tent Stove
products.body_html:
The Sweat Tent Stove is the core of the entire experience. It delivers real wood-fired heat that reaches up to 200°F+ for an authentic sauna session anywhere you set up.

Built specifically for the Sweat Tent system, this stove is designed for efficiency, durability, and consistent heat output so you can focus on the ritual, not the setup.

products.title: Large Sweat Tent Sauna Roof Cover
products.body_html: Our fiberglass sauna roof cover is fireproof, waterproof, and uv-resistant. Extend the life of your Sweat Tent and sauna with added peace of mind.

products.title: Sweat Tent Thermometer
products.body_html: A dual-gauge thermometer for monitoring temperature and humidity inside the Sweat Tent during a session. Hangs or mounts inside the tent body.

products.title: Sweat Tent Sauna Rocks (20 lbs)
products.body_html: 20 lbs of sauna rocks for the Sweat Tent stove rock basket. The rocks absorb stove heat and release it as steam when water is poured over them. Standalone purchase for replacement or backup.

products.body_html: Let people know you are a true sauna user with the Sweat Tent sauna sticker!

products.title: Chimney Cleaning Brush
products.body_html:
Our chimney cleaning brush is your ultimate solution for maintaining a clean and efficient Sweat Tent chimney! Designed specifically to tackle the stubborn buildup of creosote, this brush ensures your chimney stays clear, reducing the risk of chimney fires and enhancing the performance of your Sweat Tent.

Crafted with durable bristles and a sturdy handle, the brush is built to withstand rigorous use while providing maximum effectiveness.

Regular use of the chimney brush not only prolongs the life of your chimney but also promotes safer and more efficient heating in your Sweat Tent. Say goodbye to creosote buildup and hello to worry-free warmth with this must-have tool for every Sweat Tent owner.

products.title: Cedar Sauna Bench
products.body_html: Relax in comfort with our handcrafted cedar sauna bench. Our sauna bench is built from cedar wood and not only adds seating for two to your SweatTent but also creates a refreshing cedar scent that is sure to delight your senses. Measures 48″L x 17″W x 18.25″H.

products.title: Sweat Tent Gift Card
products.body_html: Gift the gift of Sweat Tent this season and brighten someone's day!

products.title: Eucalyptus Essential Oil
products.body_html: Our eucalyptus essential oil for saunas offers a rejuvenating and invigorating aroma that elevates your sauna tent session to new heights of relaxation and well-being. Breathe in deeply, and feel the cooling and refreshing sensation as the oil's natural compounds mingle with the steam, creating a truly immersive experience.

products.title: Torch Lighter
products.body_html: Designed with an extended neck, our long torch lighter allows you to easily reach and light wood in the back of your stove.

products.title: Wool Sauna Hat
products.body_html: Made from premium quality 100% wool, our sauna hat is designed to withstand the intense heat and humidity of saunas while providing superior insulation and breathability. The natural properties of wool ensure optimal temperature regulation, keeping your head cool and dry while you indulge in the therapeutic benefits of the sauna.

products.title: Sauna Bucket & Ladle
products.body_html: Turn your SweatTent into a steam sauna with our tastefully designed sauna bucket & ladle. Use the ergonomic metal ladle with wooden handle to pour water over the sauna rocks and create hot steam. Need to cool off? Simply pour water over yourself without needing to step outside of your sauna.
